Tab.Label: Transform
Tab.Intro: Add or remove space, rotate or mirror the scene, change its grid size, attach another scene or extract an area to a new scene. Tokens, walls, doors, lights, sounds, tiles, drawings, notes and regions move along, so everything stays where it belongs on the map. Changes are saved right away.

Mode.Label: Type
Mode.Extract: Extract an area to a new scene

Pad.Hint: Positive numbers add this many grid spaces on a side, negative numbers remove them. Unlike Foundry's padding, players can move into added space. Background and foreground images become locked tiles, so the map stays where it is.

Crop.RemoveOutsideHint: Deletes tokens, walls, lights, sounds, notes, tiles, drawings and regions entirely in the removed space. Otherwise they stay in the dark border around the scene.
Crop.Images: Cut images to the new size
Crop.ImagesHint: Saves the visible part of the background and foreground images as new files (see the module setting "Folder for cut images"), so the removed part doesn't show in the border around the scene.

Rotate.Hint: On a quarter turn, background and foreground images become locked tiles turned with the map. A half turn or a mirror keeps them as backgrounds. Mirroring turns tokens to face the mirrored way without mirroring their artwork.

Grid.Hint: The size of one grid space in pixels. The map and everything on it grow or shrink with the grid, so the scene keeps the same number of grid spaces, for example 30 × 30 at 200 px becomes 30 × 30 at 100 px.

Stitch.SpacingHint: In grid spaces. The gap leaves empty space between the two maps; the shift moves the attached map along the side, negative numbers toward the top or left.
Stitch.Hint: This scene grows to fit both maps. The other scene's map, walls, lights, sounds, notes, tiles, drawings, regions and, if ticked, tokens are copied in, scaled to this scene's grid size. The other scene isn't changed.

Extract.Intro: Creates a new scene from part of this one, for example a single building from a city map. This scene isn't changed.
Extract.AreaHint: In grid spaces, counted from the top-left corner. Or choose the area in the preview below.
Extract.Selection: Area to extract. Arrow keys move it, Shift and arrow keys resize it.
Extract.DragHint: Drag on the map to choose an area. Drag the area to move it, or its handles to resize it. Arrow keys move it, Shift and arrow keys resize it.
Extract.Name: New scene name
Extract.Hint: Everything in the area is copied: walls are cut at the edge, and background and foreground images are cut to the area (see the module setting "Folder for cut images"). All scene settings, such as lighting and grid, are taken over.
Extract.Empty: Only the map is in this area.

Options.BackupHint: Saves an untouched copy of the scene first, hidden from the navigation bar.
Options.ResetFogHint: Explored areas no longer match the map after a transformation.

Confirm.Title: Transform Scene
Confirm.Rotate: Rotate this scene and everything on it?
Confirm.Pad: Add space around this scene and move everything on it?
Confirm.Unsaved: This saves immediately. Unsaved changes in other tabs of this window will be lost.
Confirm.Grid: Change the grid size of this scene and scale everything on it?
Confirm.Mirror: Mirror this scene and everything on it?
Confirm.Crop: Change the space around this scene and move everything on it?
Confirm.Stitch: Attach a copy of "{name}" to this scene?
Confirm.Delete: {count} placeables in the removed space will be deleted.
Confirm.Restore: Restore this scene from "{name}"? The backup copy is deleted afterwards.

Notify.Restored: Restored scene "{name}" from its backup copy.

Warning.FogOverlay: This scene has a fog overlay image on a map that isn't stretched to fill the scene. The map became a tile, so the overlay can't follow it and may no longer line up.
Warning.UnknownShape: A region shape of type "{type}" isn't supported and was left in place.
Warning.CropFailed: The image of "{name}" couldn't be cut and was kept whole.
Warning.PackageFolder: The folder "{folder}" belongs to a module or system, whose updates would delete the images. They were saved in the world folder instead.
Warning.HexModes: Scenes with a hexagonal grid can't be rotated, mirrored or extracted from.

Error.InvalidAngle: Scenes can only be rotated by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
Error.HexRotation: Scenes with a hexagonal grid can't be rotated or mirrored.
Error.InvalidPadding: Space must be given in whole grid spaces.
Error.NoPadding: Enter how many grid spaces to add or remove on at least one side.
Error.NotGM: Only a Gamemaster can transform scenes.
Error.InvalidGridSize: The grid size must be a whole number of pixels, {min} or more.
Error.SameGridSize: Enter a grid size different from the current one.
Error.TooSmall: The scene would be smaller than one grid space.
Error.InvalidMirror: Scenes can only be mirrored left to right or top to bottom.
Error.StitchSide: Choose the side to attach the scene to.
Error.StitchHex: Scenes with a hexagonal grid can't be attached or attached to.
Error.StitchGap: Gap and shift must be whole grid spaces, and the gap 0 or more.
Error.NoBackup: This scene has no backup copy to restore.
Error.ExtractHex: Areas can't be extracted from scenes with a hexagonal grid.
Error.ExtractArea: Choose an area of whole grid spaces within the scene.

Restore.Label: Backup copy
Restore.Hint: Brings this scene back to how it was before the last transformation that kept a backup copy, then deletes that copy. Tokens and other placeables get their old ids back, and anything added since is removed.

ImageFolder.Name: Folder for cut images
ImageFolder.Hint: Where background and foreground images cut down by removing space are saved. Leave empty to use the world folder (worlds/<world>/niks-scene-transformations), or the same S3 bucket when the map is stored there. Module and system folders can't be used, because updates would delete the files.
